data.title: [ALLEGRO] Updating vertex and silicon wrapper resolutions and wrapper layers
data.author: armin-ilg
data.body:
Hi. This PR is linked to the one in k4geo (https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/612) that refactores the IDEA/ALLEGRO vertex detector and updates the vertex detector and silicon wrapper pitches and resolves https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/issues/617. This PR should not be merged before https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/612 is merged.

Following the recent change of baseline for the ALLEGRO inner detector (https://indico.cern.ch/event/1702794/#1-introduction), the resolutions are updated to 3 µm spatial and 5 ns timing resolution in the whole vertex detector and 50 µm/sqrt(12) spatial resolution in the silicon wrapper. 

Furthermore, thanks to a recent change in k4geo (https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/commit/0f226a98e85e739d79fc8d56fb6e738aecc22167), the array length of the resolu…

data.title: Simplify the background particle index mapping
data.author: madbaron
data.body:
Follow-up to @davidlange6's review comment in https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/413#discussion_r3933115912. The code it points at predates that PR, so it is split out here against `main`.

`OverlayTiming` built two `std::map`s per background frame to translate background particle indices into output ones. They are redundant: the background particles are cloned in order, so the copy of background particle `i` always lands at `offset + i`.

Dropping them also fixes a guard on the relation wiring: it skipped a relation when the target particle had no relations of its own, rather than when the index pointed outside the background collection. A particle referenced as a daughter whose own parent list is empty, was therefore silently dropped.

BEGINRELEASENOTES
- Simplify the backgr…

data.title: IDEA o2 seeded ECAL clustering algorithms
data.author: SanghyunKo
data.body:

- Add "seeded" ECAL clustering algorithms (`CaloDrivenClusterSeeding`, `TrackDrivenClusterSeeding`, `ClusterSeedMerging`, and `ClusterSeedGrower`)
- Add CI test for the IDEA o2 reconstruction chain

ENDRELEASENOTES

Adds the calorimeter reconstruction chain for the IDEA o2 dual-readout calorimeter (segmented-crystal ECAL + capillary-tube HCAL).

#### CreateOpticalCaloCells (RecCalorimeter)
Turns optical-photon SimCalorimeterHits into CalorimeterHits (energy = signal × calibration, position from the SimHit) and links each cell to its truth energy-deposit SimHit. data.title: DDCAD: remove CSG-based exporter
data.author: jmcarcell
data.body:
ROOT made RCsg and CsgOps.h private in [root-project/root#23421](https://github.com/root-project/root/pull/23421). DDCAD's ASSIMP writer uses that API to tessellate every exported shape, so it can no longer consume a current ROOT installation.

Question, what to do with this? This PR is the removal of what is using this CSG exporter. An alternative would be to make it a dependency of DD4hep.

BEGINRELEASENOTES
 - Remove the CSG-dependent CAD export path because ROOT's RCsg library is now private.

ENDRELEASENOTES

data.author: jbeirer
data.body:
Adds the two scripts that will drive the AI PR review, and moves PR-Agent's call settings out of the workflow into `.pr_agent.toml`.

Nothing is wired up yet: no workflow references the scripts, so reviews keep running exactly as they do today. A follow-up switches the workflow over to them, which is why this is split in two — with the scripts already on `main`, that follow-up can be reviewed by the pipeline it introduces.

`.github/scripts/ai_pr_review.py` does two jobs:

- with `--check`, it reads the event and decides which commands it requests — same-repo non-draft pull requests, or a `/` command from a contributor — so the decision happens before any self-hosted runner is involved;

data.title: fix: require --compactFile in CKF, GNN, and geometry-visualization options
data.author: jbeirer
data.body:
BEGINRELEASENOTES
- Fixed a cryptic Gaudi `TypeError`/`ValueError` when `--compactFile` was omitted in `CLD_CKFTracking.py`, `runGNNTrackFinding.py`, and `test_visualize_acts_geo.py` by making the argument required, with a clear error message.

ENDRELEASENOTES

## Summary

`--compactFile` was optional in several options scripts. When omitted, the resulting `None` reached `GeoSvc`'s `detectors` property as `[None]`, which failed deep in Gaudi's `PropertyProxy._isCompatible` with a cryptic `TypeError: NoneType takes no arguments` / `ValueError: received an instance of <class 'NoneType'>, but <class 'NoneType'> expected for property detectors`.

Marking `--compactFile` `required=True` in the three affected scripts fails fast with a readable argparse error instead.
